crossRefs.note: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple…
As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned…
If it seems evil to you to serve Yahweh, choose today whom you will serve; whether the gods which your fathers served…
Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you: but I will instruct…
David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.
As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?
For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the…
What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?
My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

translations.web: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.
translations.bsb: But as for me, my feet had almost stumbled; my steps had nearly slipped.
translations.kjv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
translations.asv: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; My steps had well nigh slipped.
